```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```



```{r}

churn <- read.csv("C:/Users/ethan/OneDrive/Documents/CSV Data/WA_Fn-UseC_-Telco-Customer-Churn.csv")

head(churn)

churn$Churn <- ifelse(churn$Churn == "Yes", 1, 0)

churn$gender <- factor(churn$gender)
churn$Partner <- factor(churn$Partner)
churn$Dependents <- factor(churn$Dependents)
churn$PhoneService <- factor(churn$PhoneService)
churn$MultipleLines <- factor(churn$MultipleLines)
churn$InternetService <- factor(churn$InternetService)
churn$OnlineSecurity <- factor(churn$OnlineSecurity)
churn$OnlineBackup <- factor(churn$OnlineBackup)
churn$DeviceProtection <- factor(churn$DeviceProtection)
churn$TechSupport <- factor(churn$TechSupport)
churn$StreamingTV <- factor(churn$StreamingTV)
churn$StreamingMovies <- factor(churn$StreamingMovies)
churn$Contract <- factor(churn$Contract)
churn$PaperlessBilling <- factor(churn$PaperlessBilling)
churn$PaymentMethod <- factor(churn$PaymentMethod)

```


```{r}

model1 <- glm(Churn ~ gender, 
             data = churn, 
             family = binomial)

summary(model1)

```


```{r}

model2 <- glm(Churn ~ gender +
               Partner +
               Dependents +
               tenure +
               InternetService +
               OnlineSecurity +
               TechSupport +
               Contract +
               PaperlessBilling +
               PaymentMethod +
               MonthlyCharges, 
             data = churn, 
             family = binomial)

summary(model2)


```



```{r}

model3 <- glm(Churn ~ tenure +
               InternetService +
               OnlineSecurity +
               TechSupport +
               Contract +
               PaperlessBilling +
               PaymentMethod +
               MonthlyCharges, 
             data = churn, 
             family = binomial)

summary(model3)

```


```{r}
library(broom)

tidy(
  model3,
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE
)

```







```{r}


AIC(model1, model2, model3)


```
